correctness.rationale: PASS: On X0!=0 eliminate Q and transform to coordinates a=X1/X0, z=X2/X0-a², y=X3/X0-a³ to get hypersurface y²+z³=0; similarly on X4!=0. In char 3 the Jacobian ideal is (y,z³). The only points with X0=X4=0 are [0:1:0:0:0] and [0:0:0:1:0]; direct gradient rank is two at each, hence no omitted singular support. On the singular subscheme X4/X0=a^4 and b=a^-1,zprime=a^-4 z EXACTLY, no higher nilpotent corrections. That transition gives split symmetric nilpotent algebra with line bundle O(-4) and its square O(-8); the hyperplane ratio yields O_J(1)=π*O(4). Direct-sum Euler characteristics sum (4m-4j+1) to 12m-9; deg=12,p_a=10 and h0 formula follow by P1 cohomology. The global projective reduced CI is unmixed and integral on dense chart, with no extra surface at X0=0; its tangent parametrization matches it. Inspected exact finite-field verifier equations and independent symbolic chart/gradient reasoning; no use of finite rank checks as proof of the global algebra.

value.rationale: PASS: The Jacobian singular subscheme is a canonical geometric invariant, unlike mere equation renaming. Characteristic three kills the transverse cubic derivative and raises the local cusp singular-scheme length from 2 (ordinary characteristic) to 3. The exact degree-four twist of the nilpotent generator determines degree/genus/sheaf sections and is not inferable from reduced singular support or generic cycle multiplicity alone. A fully explicit wild-characteristic scheme structure is intrinsically useful, with no paper-size or arbitrary-dimension requirement.

Its intrinsic Jacobian singular scheme is the split triple thickening of the rational quartic with π_*O_J=O⊕O(-4)ε⊕O(-8)ε², ε³=0 and O_J(1)=π*O(4), degree12, Hilbert polynomial12m-9, genus10 and h0(J,O_J(m))=Σ_{j=0}² max(4m-4j+1,0) for all m>=0.
